name: Charred Halloumi & Tomato Traybake Curry
steps: Heat the grill to high. Toast the cumin and coriander seeds in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2-3 mins, until fragrant. Tip into a pestle and mortar and grind to a rough powder, then mix in the ground turmeric. Cut the halloumi into chunky cubes and toss with the spice mix.

Tip the cherry tomatoes into a large baking tray, top with the spiced halloumi and drizzle with olive oil. Slide under the grill for 4-5 mins, until the halloumi is beginning to char and the tomatoes are starting to blister and burst.

Remove the tray from the grill. Turn the grill off and heat the oven to 200°C fan. Scoop half the cherry tomatoes into a blender, squeeze in the juice of the lime, pour in the coconut milk, then spoon in the tamarind paste and fish sauce (you can substitute for soy sauce to keep it veggie). Add a good grind of salt and pepper, then blitz until completely smooth.

Tip the rice straight into the tray (no need to microwave, it will cook in the sauce) and mix well, then pour over the sauce. Transfer to the oven for 20 mins, until bubbling and the curry sauce has thickened.
Pick the coriander leaves and scatter over the curry, spoon over the crispy chilli oil and serve straight from the tray.
